open_questions: Why were FY25 audited statements delayed (RNS 25 Feb and 12 Mar 2026), and does the 23 Mar 2025 Annual Results pack show a clean audit opinion, emphasis of matter, restatement, or control finding that still matters for a trade?

After the 1 Jun 2026 trading update cut FY26 profit expectations on weaker French consumer demand (~22% share-price headlines) and the 13 Jul 2026 H1 pack claiming the group is on track for revised guidance, what is the current PBT/EBITDA range and how much of any recovery is France versus Wash.ME/laundry mix?

Is the screen yield (~6.9%) and dividend-growth family still valid given Yahoo FY25 FCF of £25.2m versus dividends paid of £29.8m, screen notes of FCF coverage below 1.0× (gross −0.90×, net 0.84×), rising machine capex, and falling cash (£77.5m to £56.5m)—does the filing definition of cash generation cover the stated policy, or is a trim still the base case?

Is Identification/photobooth structurally impaired (German ID-photo rule change; H1 photobooth and margin pressure) such that quality/moat screens are stale, or do laundry, ASDA Wash.ME, and unit economics offset with durable returns on incremental machines?

What residual governance, control, and overhang risk remains after the Dec 2025 offer-period/Form 8.3–8.5 activity, Jan 2026 secondary placing, GM/Rule 9 waiver and buyback, Deputy CEO/COO/duty changes, and the June 2026 ‘boardroom problem’ headlines?

The snapshot is strong_buy (15/22 models, new 1-week signal, price slightly below the 200-day MA) while the embedded research overlay still says Accumulate/Medium and an interim-quality haircut to Buy—should the memo confirm strong-buy or keep the overlay?

Do FY25 notes confirm customer/site concentration and bank-covenant headroom after cash drawdown, inventory build, and the buyback, or are those still gaps versus the overlay’s claim that concentration was resolved?

procedural_suggestions.summary: De-duplicate filings: Investegate RNS, IR allowlist PDFs, and Google News mirrors often share body_path; IR trading-update is tagged period=interim while the RNS is trading_update; ‘Notice of Annual/Interim Results’ is ranked as annual/interim ahead of the actual results; Companies House headlines lack fiscal year; index body_path still points at docs/data/research/MEGP.L rather than the trial tree; 65 body files vs 64 indexed.

alternate_news is thin/unavailable (inventory false) even though news_batch_*.json files sit in sources; news_manifest is headline-only with duplicate Google News URLs and generic penny-stock/dividend listicles; Yahoo financials_annual has empty quarterly_income so H1 2026 figures are not in the Yahoo pack and must come from the interim body.

Director/worker prompts should forbid selecting Notice of Results as the annual/interim body, require audit-delay and June guidance-cut as mandatory extracts, and instruct workers to take P&L/cash/FCF/dividend figures from filing bodies rather than Yahoo when both exist. Do not spawn workers against invented alternate_news.

tasks.focus: FY25 Annual Results RNS (23 Mar 2026), not the February notice. Extract FY25 vs FY24 revenue, operating profit, PBT, EPS, OCF, capex, FCF (quote the definition used), net cash/debt, dividend (pence and cover), segment and geography mix (photobooth vs laundry; France vs UK/other), customer/site concentration, covenants/headroom, going-concern and audit opinion including any link to the Feb–Mar accounts delay, related-party/control and capital-return language. Prefer these figures over Yahoo.

2026 Interim Results RNS (13 Jul 2026). Extract H1 2026 vs H1 2025 P&L, cash, net debt, interim dividend, cash generation vs dividend, original vs revised FY26 guidance and whether management says it is on track, France/consumer-demand commentary versus the 1 Jun trading update, photobooth vs Wash.ME/laundry trends, ASDA or other partnership contribution, and any change to dividend policy or capex. Do not use Yahoo quarterly (empty).

Headline-only digest: cluster duplicates; keep material items (Jun profit-expectation cut and France wobble, Jul H1 ‘on track’/earnings-quality critiques, boardroom article, ASDA partnership, German photobooth rules, Aberdeen holding); discount penny-stock and generic dividend roundups; flag claims that cannot be verified without article bodies. Do not treat this as alternate_news.

Reconcile strong_buy (15/22 models; families cheapness, quality, dividend, GARP, risk; P/E 7.8, P/B 2.2, yield 6.9%, ROE 28.2%, D/E 28%; Yahoo FCF £25.2m; 1 week at signal; RSI 54; price −0.1% vs SMA200) with action_note/research_verdict Accumulate/Medium and the interim-quality overlay (interim EPS down, FCF coverage <1×, adjusted Buy). List which screen claims filings must confirm or overturn. Do not treat Yahoo FCF as filing-grade.

Record thin/missing ladder steps, especially alternate_news=false. Note Yahoo quarterly_income empty, news_batch files present but not classified as alternate_news, 65 body files vs 64 indexed, duplicate/shared body_paths, and IR published_at null. List what the memo cannot verify locally. Do not invent unavailable sources.
